title: Oceanic Original Korean Gorgonzola Dolce Sujebi
description: A salty, springy, nostalgic Korean dish featuring gorgonzola-dolce, leaf-wrap-steam, pescatarian-friendly sujebi cooked on a binchotan-grill
instructions: Preheat the binchotan-grill to medium-high heat
Prepare the sujebi dough according to package instructions
Cut the dough into small pieces and shape into sujebi
In a bowl, mix together crumbled gorgonzola dolce, Korean chili flakes, garlic, salt, and black pepper
Place a small spoonful of the gorgonzola mixture onto the center of each sujebi
Top the gorgonzola mixture with a fresh scallop
Wrap each sujebi with a napa cabbage leaf
Brush the binchotan-grill with sesame oil to prevent sticking
Grill the sujebi for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the cabbage is slightly charred
Serve the sujebi hot, garnished with additional gorgonzola dolce if desired
